Thursday Night Central Columbus & Metro Parks Ride

Columbus, OH · Brewery District · Social · Road

No-dropBeginner friendly

Thursday Night Central Columbus & Metro Parks Ride is a social and road group ride in Columbus, OH. It rolls every Thursday at 6:30 pm from Nocterra Brewing bike racks, Scioto Audubon Metro Park. Pace: pace D, social and relaxed. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: pace D, social and relaxed. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @outdoor_pursuits the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Thursday Night Central Columbus & Metro Parks Ride group ride

A relaxed, no-drop ride on Central Ohio's trail network with little road riding. Meant for newer and returning riders. Mid-ride refreshment stops are common and everyone is back before dark.
